sections.content: How many people are "bar and catering supervisors"?

42,550 people

were counted on the census as "bar and catering supervisors" in England and Wales in March 2021.
Bar and catering supervisors oversee the activities of those working in the catering industry, in bars, restaurants and other establishments.

People who had this job were generally younger

The occupation of "bar and catering supervisors" had a younger age profile compared with the whole working population.

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 20 to 24 years. Of the whole working population 7.9% were aged 20 to 24 years. For people working as "bar and catering supervisors", 23.7% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "bar and catering supervisors" was 65 years or older.

sections.content:
Other jobs that had a similar age profile to "bar and catering supervisors" included:

  • call and contact centre occupations
  • advertising and marketing associate professionals
  • early education and childcare practitioners

Select your age group to see the ten most popular occupations for your age

More women than men had this job

Among people working as "bar and catering supervisors" there were more women than men (62.8% compared with 37.2%).

This means "bar and catering supervisors" had a different proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "elementary administration and service occupations".

Men made up 37.2% and women made up 62.8% of "bar and catering supervisors"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "bar and catering supervisors" included:

  • interior designers
  • pensions and insurance clerks and assistants
  • biochemists and biomedical scientists

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

We can look at who worked as "bar and catering supervisors" by age group and for men and women at the same time to see how these two factors interact.

Among those aged under 30 years old, we see there is a higher proportion of men with this occupation than women.

The percentage of men and women who are "bar and catering supervisors" across age groups

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "bar and catering supervisors", 9.8% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had a younger age profile compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (58.1% compared with 41.9%).

They are also more likely to be an employee (99.3%) than self-employed (0.7%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was London. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Birmingham, this is in the region of the West Midlands.
